0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 4th in the East) as they look to bounce back from a 1-2 start that includes a 1-0 road record, while Toronto is 1-0 at home and is coming off a loss. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Kawhi Leonard listed as day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision. The Magic lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, and their last meeting was a 139-87 Raptors win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
